profiles.protocolDocumentVersion: resgrid-json-v1
profiles.setupSummary: POST the documented Resgrid JSON position payload to the generated HTTPS endpoint.
profiles.retryExpectation: Retry on 429 and 503. Treat 200, 201, 202, and 204 as successful delivery.

profiles.setupSummary: Configure Traccar v6.14.5 JSON position forwarding. Use a per-device capability URL when one Traccar server forwards multiple devices.
profiles.retryExpectation: Enable Traccar position-forwarding retries. Resgrid returns 202 after durable queue acceptance and 429 or 503 for retryable failures.

profiles.protocolDocumentVersion: Teltonika Data Sending Protocols; reviewed 2026-07-26
profiles.setupSummary: Configure the device to send Codec8 or Codec8 Extended AVL data to the Resgrid Teltonika listener using its IMEI identifier.
profiles.retryExpectation: Retain records until Resgrid returns an accepted-record count matching the transmitted AVL record count.

profiles.protocolDocumentVersion: Traccar v6.14.5 gl200 behavior at 5c5e710d; model certification pending
profiles.setupSummary: Configure the GV57MG to send bounded Queclink @Track text reports over TCP using its 15-digit IMEI identifier.
profiles.retryExpectation: Retain and retry position reports until delivery succeeds according to the configured Queclink acknowledgement mode; heartbeat reports require the matching Resgrid SACK response.
